All of the packages listed below have been preinstalled, so please do not install packages again. You can just run the r chunk below to load all of the packages.
```{r}
library(factoextra)
library(NbClust)
library(tidyverse)

data("USArrests")
```


This week we are going to find clusters of states by their crime statistics.

1. Identify the "optimal/best" number of clusters using the murder and population variables.

2. Cluster the data with the "best" number of clusters using the murder and population variables.

3. Repeat steps 1-2 with your own choice of the available variables.
